text:
Omar H: hey folks, first morning setup — laptop enrolled but MDM enrollment keeps failing during OOBE. I'm on the office wifi but it drops to a captive portal that asks me to accept terms. After I sign in the browser, the enrollment still times out. Anyone seen this?
Priya (IT): welcome Omar! we have a known issue where the guest/captive portal blocks the device enrollment SCEP callback. Which SSID are you on (Corp vs Guest)?
Omar H: connected to "Redwood-Staff" (I clicked the popup and signed the portal). It shows "Accepted" in the browser. Enrollment status in the setup assistant says "Waiting for MDM" then errors with "Network unreachable".
Network Bot: wlan01: Omar's device (serial: redacted) authenticated on Redwood-Staff. Captive portal passed. Network ACL: device isolated until device posture check completes.
Priya (IT): thanks. It might be an NAC posture rule — our switch applies a temporary microsegmentation until the MDM enrollment registers the device certificate. Try toggling Wi-Fi off/on and re-run the setup assistant. If that doesn't work, connect via phone hotspot (no captive) briefly to finish enrollment.
Omar H: toggled Wi-Fi, still same. I can tether via my phone but I don't want to use personal hotspot for onboarding if there's a corporate option.
IT Helpdesk: filing ticket #INC-91822, tagging Network and MDM teams. For now, we can push a manual enrollment token if you DM the device serial.
mdm-bot: Available actions: "push-enroll-token", "resend-profiles", "check-scep-status". Use DM to request targeted actions.
Priya (IT): @Omar H please DM me the serial. We can push a one-time enrollment token that bypasses the posture gate for initial setup only. After enrollment completes the NAC will update and apply proper tags.
Omar H: DM sent. Also seeing a certificate error in Safari: "This connection is not private" referencing our internal CA when I hit the portal.
Sam (Security): quick security note: do NOT accept or install any unknown root certs from the captive portal. If the portal is trying to inject a CA, that's a red flag. However, our captive normally uses a redirect only. Can you screenshot the cert dialog and DM it to me?
Priya (IT): pushed the one-time token. mdm-bot will attempt delivery. Keep the lid open and stay on the corporate Wi-Fi; it should handshake within ~2 minutes.
mdm-bot: push-enroll-token: Delivered -> Enrollment started -> Enrollment complete. SCEP certificate issued to system keychain.
Omar H: I got a prompt "Profile Installed" and now the setup progressed past "Waiting for MDM". No cert warnings now. Thanks all.
Sam (Security): great. I'll follow up with Network team to confirm the captive portal isn't presenting cert install prompts. If anyone else sees a "Install Certificate" prompt during onboarding, stop and ping security before accepting.
IT Helpdesk: closing ticket #INC-91822 as resolved. If any post-enroll network issues occur, reopen and tag @Priya (IT). :white_check_mark:
